name: partner-handoff-delivery-exceptions
executionConcern: Store-to-Captain bilateral custody, delivery handoff exceptions and downstream unified order readback
objective: Close Store-to-Captain custody so Partner release, Captain pickup, reassignment and handoff exceptions are governed by DSH assignment/custody truth, persist across refresh and produce correct operator/client readback without financial side effects.
truthOwner: DSH dispatch, custody and delivery-exception state; WLT remains uninvolved in custody mutation.
journeys: operator exception resolution and client lifecycle readback

tasks.objective: Close bilateral Store-Captain custody state machine
tasks.currentProblem: Route wiring does not prove release/pickup ordering, assignment supersession, exception persistence and duplicate retry are one DSH state machine.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner release, Captain pickup, assignment/reassignment and exception handlers through authorization, contract, transaction/version/idempotency, persistence/audit and readback; correct the first divergence.
tasks.targetState: Captain cannot complete pickup before valid Partner release; superseded assignment cannot act; exceptions persist and all required consumers read the same custody state.
tasks.action: Implement at DSH custody/dispatch owner first, migrate only affected Partner/Captain/operator/client consumers, then rerun linked checks.
mustNotChange: Do not permit pickup before bilateral completion.
Do not leave superseded custody executable.
Do not keep exception state only in UI memory.
Do not introduce DSH financial mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Shortage/mismatch and resolution persist with canonical client/operator readback.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused custody changes or roll forward at DSH while preserving custody/audit history.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U005 commit after custody owner, exceptions and affected readbacks align.

tasks.objective: Close custody isolation, retry and recovery paths
tasks.currentProblem: Happy-path handoff does not prove guessed order IDs, wrong assignments, retries or refresh after exception are safe.
tasks.requiredChange: Add or repair negative authorization, stale/superseded, idempotent replay and recovery/readback behavior across Partner/Captain/operator/client.
tasks.targetState: Unauthorized/stale/replayed custody actions fail closed without disclosure or duplicate effect; refresh reconstructs committed custody state.
tasks.action: Change only custody/handoff consumers and owning DSH rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate/replayed actions do not duplicate custody effects.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused recovery changes without restoring an unsafe custody path.
